request.system:
You are the verifier judge in Ledger. You check whether each clause of an extracted COBOL business rule is supported by the source lines it cites.

For each clause you get its text and the cited lines (marked with >>), with a few surrounding lines for context only. A clause may cite more than one span (for example a statement in the program plus a field declaration in a copybook); judge it on all of its cited spans together. A clause is supported when the cited lines, read with ordinary COBOL semantics, establish what the clause says. Mark it unsupported if it states something the cited lines do not show, gets a condition, comparison, sign, code or message wrong, or relies mainly on lines outside the cited span. Be strict about meaning, not about wording. Give a one-sentence reason either way.

Rule BR-CBTRN02C-004: Reject a transaction that originated after the account expiration date (overrides over-limit)

### given[0]: The account record was found for the cross-referenced account ID.
fields=['ACCOUNT-RECORD'] literals=[]
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   391            END-READ
   392            EXIT.
   393        1500-B-LOOKUP-ACCT.
   394            MOVE XREF-ACCT-ID TO FD-ACCT-ID
>> 395            READ ACCOUNT-FILE INTO ACCOUNT-RECORD
>> 396               INVALID KEY
>> 397                 MOVE 101 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 398                 MOVE 'ACCOUNT RECORD NOT FOUND'
>> 399                   TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 400               NOT INVALID KEY
   401       *         DISPLAY 'ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT:' ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT
   402       *         DISPLAY 'TRAN-AMT         :' DALYTRAN-AMT
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT

### given[1]: The account expiration date is a 10-character text field, and the transaction origination timestamp is a 26-character text field.
fields=['ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE', 'DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS'] literals=[]
CVACT01Y.cpy:
     7            05  ACCT-CURR-BAL                     PIC S9(10)V99.
     8            05  ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT                 PIC S9(10)V99.
     9            05  ACCT-CASH-CREDIT-LIMIT            PIC S9(10)V99.
    10            05  ACCT-OPEN-DATE                    PIC X(10).
>>  11            05  ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE               PIC X(10).
    12            05  ACCT-REISSUE-DATE                 PIC X(10).
    13            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT              PIC S9(10)V99.
    14            05  ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT               PIC S9(10)V99.
    15            05  ACCT-ADDR-ZIP                     PIC X(10).
CVTRA06Y.cpy:
    12            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-NAME                  PIC X(50).
    13            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-CITY                  PIC X(50).
    14            05  DALYTRAN-MERCHANT-ZIP                   PIC X(10).
    15            05  DALYTRAN-CARD-NUM                       PIC X(16).
>>  16            05  DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS                        PIC X(26).
    17            05  DALYTRAN-PROC-TS                        PIC X(26).
    18            05  FILLER                                  PIC X(20).
    19       *
    20       * Ver: CardDemo_v1.0-15-g27d6c6f-68 Date: 2022-07-19 23:16:01 CDT

### when[0]: The expiration date is less than the first 10 characters of the origination timestamp. The comparison is character by character, and an equal date passes.
fields=['ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE', 'DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS'] literals=['1:10']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
   412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
   417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
   418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
   419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF

### then[0]: The failure reason is set to 103 and the description to 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['103', 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   413                 END-IF
   414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
   415                   CONTINUE
   416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
   420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*

### then[1]: The expiration check runs after the credit-limit check, whatever that check found. If both fail, reason 103 and its description overwrite reason 102.
fields=['WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON', 'WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC'] literals=['102', '103']
CBTRN02C.cbl:
   403                 COMPUTE WS-TEMP-BAL = ACCT-CURR-CYC-CREDIT
   404                                     - ACCT-CURR-CYC-DEBIT
   405                                     + DALYTRAN-AMT
   406 
>> 407                 IF ACCT-CREDIT-LIMIT >= WS-TEMP-BAL
>> 408                   CONTINUE
>> 409                 ELSE
>> 410                   MOVE 102 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 411                   MOVE 'OVERLIMIT TRANSACTION'
>> 412                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 413                 END-IF
>> 414                 IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10)
>> 415                   CONTINUE
>> 416                 ELSE
>> 417                   MOVE 103 TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON
>> 418                   MOVE 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION'
>> 419                     TO WS-VALIDATION-FAIL-REASON-DESC
>> 420                 END-IF
   421            END-READ
   422            EXIT.
   423       *---------------------------------------------------------------*
   424        2000-POST-TRANSACTION.

content.text: {"verdicts":[{"clause":"given[0]","supported":true,"reason":"The cited READ with its NOT INVALID KEY branch shows that the following logic runs only when the account record is found by XREF-ACCT-ID."},{"clause":"given[1]","supported":true,"reason":"The copybooks declare ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE as PIC X(10) and DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS as PIC X(26)."},{"clause":"when[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Line 414 tests IF ACCT-EXPIRAION-DATE >= DALYTRAN-ORIG-TS (1:10) and takes the ELSE branch, so failure happens when the expiration date is less; an alphanumeric comparison is character by character, and equality falls into CONTINUE."},{"clause":"then[0]","supported":true,"reason":"Lines 417-419 move 103 and 'TRANSACTION RECEIVED AFTER ACCT EXPIRATION' to the reason and description fields."},{"clause":"then[1]","supported":true,"reason":"The expiration IF follows the credit-limit IF unconditionally within NOT INVALID KEY, so when both fail, the MOVEs of 103 and its description overwrite the earlier 102 values."}]}
